label: RU — cherkashino.ru on Timeweb (Moscow), operator subject to 152-FZ
$schema-note: Read by deploy/scripts/instance-check.mjs. docs/instances/RULES.md is the prose this file enforces; edit both together.

domains.note: instance-check --db fails on a tenant with no address on these domains, and on a tenant with an address on a domain intl.json names: every other shop belongs to INTL (docs/instances/RULES.md, the first lines and §1). The two xn-- hosts are the shop's addresses in the .рф zone, held by the same tenant in the RU database.

school.note: The school cabinet (apps/school, the `school` service of deploy/compose.mt.yml) on its own host. It reads the buyers and their courses of the shop SCHOOL_SHOP_ORIGIN names, so it runs on that shop's instance. instance-check fails a SCHOOL_DOMAIN outside this list and a SCHOOL_SHOP_ORIGIN on another instance's domain (docs/instances/RULES.md §1).

dataResidency.primaryBackup: RU host local disk, deploy/backup/ tier 1
dataResidency.secondaryBackup: S3 Timeweb Cloud (RU region) only — never the Contabo host, never an EU/US bucket

forbiddenNames.name: RESEND_API_KEY
forbiddenNames.reason: Resend is a US mail provider; RU customer data has no 152-FZ transfer basis to send it there

forbiddenNames.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID
forbiddenNames.reason: Google Analytics 4 sends visitor data to Google (US); forbidden on RU per Ivan's order

forbiddenNames.name: GA_MEASUREMENT_ID
forbiddenNames.reason: same as NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID — the single-store storefront build-time fallback

forbiddenNames.name: PAYMENTS_CRYPTO_AVAILABLE
forbiddenNames.reason: switches cryptocurrency payments (BTCPay, Bitcart and x402) on in the backend and panel — forbidden on RU, where Federal Law 282-FZ Art. 1 part 6 bans accepting cryptocurrency for goods

forbiddenPrefixes.reason: Tribute is INTL-only (Wallet Pay, crypto rails, non-RU payment entity) — forbidden on RU
the x402 crypto payment protocol (t-2026-10-03-33) is INTL-only — forbidden on RU

Federal Law 282-FZ of 04.08.2026 «On Digital Currencies and Digital Rights», Art. 1 part 6 (in force since 2026-09-01), forbids a Russian tax resident or company from accepting cryptocurrency for goods; it replaced 259-FZ Art. 14(5), repealed from 2026-09-01 by 283-FZ Art. 22
BTCPay Server (crypto payments, ask-20261005-070255-438f) is INTL-only — forbidden on RU, where 282-FZ Art. 1 part 6 bans accepting cryptocurrency for goods
Bitcart (crypto payments, ask-20261005-070255-438f) is INTL-only — forbidden on RU, where 282-FZ Art. 1 part 6 bans accepting cryptocurrency for goods

backup.note: instance-check --backup-env fails when S3_ENABLED=1 points S3_ENDPOINT_URL at a host outside s3EndpointHosts, and when CROSS_COPY_SSH_HOST names a host outside crossCopyHosts. The lists are allowlists: a second host or bucket in Russia is added here and in docs/instances/RULES.md §1 before it is used. envFileOnHost is the file on the host that carries those keys; deploy/scripts/deploy-instance.sh hands it to the check.

mailRelay.description: self-hosted outbound-only relay on the RU host (same shape as deploy/mt/MAIL.md's mail service), or another provider whose own processing stays inside Russia
mailRelay.note: deploy/compose.mt.yml's defaults for the relay's own name and sender domain are the INTL host's. instance-check fails when SMTP_HOST is the stack's own relay and MAIL_HOSTNAME or MAIL_SENDER_DOMAINS is not set here, and on either instance when SMTP_FROM is not an address in a domain the relay signs for.

notes: Since 04.10.2026 (checklist K15) buyers sign in on RU with Yandex ID only, and instance-check --db fails on a tenant whose buyer_login_method needs another provider. Were Telegram sign-in or the shop bot ever allowed on RU again, they must be named — including that Telegram's operating entity is outside Russia — in the privacy policy, with a consent separate from the general personal-data consent (docs/instances/RULES.md §2). instance-check.mjs cannot verify page text, so this is a paper requirement, not a check here.
Stands and local development against this instance's data must use anonymised or synthetic data only (docs/instances/RULES.md §3).

SCHOOL_SSO_RETURN_HOSTS (t-2026-10-08-36) is allowed here and only here: the school at school.cherkashina.ru signs its buyers in through this shop, and the backend and the storefront send a sign-in code only to the hosts it lists (school.cherkashina.ru). intl.json forbids the variable (docs/instances/RULES.md §2).
